$comment: Directories or files under src/ that are kept but not reachable from src/cli.ts or src/index.ts. Each entry needs a wire deadline (the release by which it must be reachable) and a delete deadline (the release by which it is removed if still unwired). See ADR 0016 and Docs/implementation-plans/v3.2.0-plan.md section 5.6.

exemptions.reason: Roadmap V4 (handoff summaries) and V3 (project memory). Redaction is wired in 3.2.0 by block R and leaves this list once reachable.
Roadmap V4: durable job event log, the base for aibr following work instead of agents polling.
Roadmap V1: Codex as a project orchestrator and worker runtime.
Roadmap V1: runtime discovery for the Codex and OpenCode orchestrators.
